question: Why did Nvidia's revenue jump in fiscal 2024?
summary: Nvidia's revenue rose in FY2024: $26.97B -> $60.92B (+125.9%). The evidence is consistent with these drivers: (1) demand outstripped supply and pricing power rose (gross margin expanded with revenue); (2) sales ran ahead of inventory (demand-led growth).
supported: Demand outstripped supply and pricing power rose (gross margin expanded with revenue)
Sales ran ahead of inventory (demand-led growth)
Operating leverage amplified the move (operating income moved more than revenue)

H1: Demand outstripped supply and pricing power rose (gross margin expanded with revenue)
H2: Sales ran ahead of inventory (demand-led growth)
H3: Operating leverage amplified the move (operating income moved more than revenue)

reference: Revenue rose 126% to $60.9B, led by Data Center (+217%) on demand for Hopper GPUs for large language models (NVIDIA FY2024 10-K). Because has no segment data, so only 'demand-led' is checkable.
